headline: The phone now teaches the clap — PLAICRAFT's ±50 ms proof coaches itself
lede: Slot b graded every human take on the PLAICRAFT store this shift: all three replay-verify against the sim, two pass voice, and none could ever prove audio alignment — because every take heard zero claps and nothing had ever asked the player to clap. The fix is a one-shot coach pill at the recorder's live-REC moment, shipped and live.

notes.text: Store graded: 3/3 takes replay-verify (incl. the valkyrie full run as stored), voice 2/3 — the third stays honestly red naming its pre-fix frozen 816 ms clock, exactly as designed.

Clap coach (#1711): green-REC, once per device, instruction never a claim — pure rules pinned 207/207 with a hand-mutant kill, plus live browser proof that a fresh device gets the lesson and a taught one doesn't.

A flake must be fingerprinted before it's excused: the off-tempo pacing failures reproduced on unmodified main under load ~9 and in the profile's own pre-dating history — evidence, not vibes, closed that question.
S1's last acceptance line is now purely human: one phone Gauntlet take + one claptest session with consent YES+YES, and the grader posts the ±50 ms verdict by itself.

look.text: Gauntlet — voice takes now coach the sync clap at run start
